requirements.quote:
Packet protection keys are not discarded immediately when new keys
   are available.
requirements.condition: When packet-protection keys for a newer encryption level become available.
requirements.required_behavior: Retain the previous encryption-level keys until their discard conditions are satisfied.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Discarding previous keys solely because newer keys became available.
requirements.why_checkable: Key-lifecycle instrumentation can verify that installation of newer keys does not itself delete previous keys.

requirements.quote:
If packets from a lower encryption level contain
   CRYPTO frames, frames that retransmit that data MUST be sent at the
   same encryption level.
requirements.condition: When retransmitting data from a CRYPTO frame that was sent at a lower encryption level.
requirements.required_behavior: Send the retransmitted CRYPTO data at the same encryption level as the original data.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Retransmitting the CRYPTO data at a different encryption level.
requirements.why_checkable: A loss-and-retransmission trace can compare the encryption levels of original and retransmitted CRYPTO data.

requirements.quote:
Similarly, an endpoint generates
   acknowledgments for packets at the same encryption level as the
   packet being acknowledged.
requirements.condition: When generating an acknowledgment for a packet.
requirements.required_behavior: Generate the acknowledgment at the same encryption level as the acknowledged packet.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Acknowledging the packet at a different encryption level.
requirements.why_checkable: Packet traces can correlate each ACK with the encryption level of the acknowledged packet.

requirements.quote:
An endpoint cannot discard keys for a given encryption level unless
   it has received all the cryptographic handshake messages from its
   peer at that encryption level and its peer has done the same.
requirements.condition: Before an endpoint discards keys for an encryption level.
requirements.required_behavior: Confirm that it has received all cryptographic handshake messages from its peer at that encryption level.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Discarding the keys while peer handshake messages at that level remain unreceived.
requirements.why_checkable: A handshake trace can compare key deletion with completion of the peer's CRYPTO byte stream at that level.

requirements.quote:
An endpoint cannot discard keys for a given encryption level unless
   it has received all the cryptographic handshake messages from its
   peer at that encryption level and its peer has done the same.
requirements.condition: Before an endpoint discards keys for an encryption level.
requirements.required_behavior: Confirm that its peer has received all cryptographic handshake messages sent at that encryption level.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Discarding the keys before the peer has received all handshake messages at that level.
requirements.why_checkable: Acknowledgment state for sent CRYPTO data can be compared with the key-discard event.

requirements.quote:
Though an endpoint might retain older keys, new data MUST be sent at
   the highest currently available encryption level.
requirements.condition: When an endpoint sends new data while multiple encryption levels' keys are retained.
requirements.required_behavior: Send the new data at the highest currently available encryption level.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Sending new data at a lower retained encryption level.
requirements.why_checkable: A packet trace can compare new-data sends with the highest keys installed at send time.

requirements.quote:
Only ACK frames
   and retransmissions of data in CRYPTO frames are sent at a previous
   encryption level.  These packets MAY also include PADDING frames.
requirements.condition: When sending a packet at a previous encryption level.
requirements.required_behavior: Limit its substantive content to ACK frames and retransmitted CRYPTO data, while permitting PADDING frames in the packet.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Including any other frame or new data at the previous encryption level.
requirements.why_checkable: Frame-type inspection can verify the complete allowed set in every packet sent at a previous level.
